possibility_en: How "you" act in the dream (watching, fleeing, helping, freezing) often mirrors an attitude you hold awake. Changes in the dream ego across a series can track real growth.
possibility_zh: 梦里的“你”如何行动（旁观、逃跑、帮助、僵住），往往映照出清醒时的某种态度；在一系列梦中它的变化，可以反映真实的成长。
questions_en: How am I acting in this dream? | What do I avoid doing? | What would I do differently if I could go back in?
questions_zh: 我在梦里是怎样行动的？| 我回避了什么？| 如果能回到梦里，我会怎么做？
avoid: Judging the dreamer for what the dream ego did.
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), p. 18; Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), pp. 97, 103–106

aliases: shadow|enemy|rival|intruder|someone I dislike|阴影|敌人|入侵者
possibility_en: Qualities you prefer not to see in yourself, often shown by a figure you dislike, fear, or feel embarrassed by. The shadow also holds undeveloped potential, not only faults.
possibility_zh: 你不愿承认的自身特质，常化身为你讨厌、害怕或令你尴尬的人物。阴影里也藏着尚未发展的潜能，并不只是缺点。
questions_en: What quality in this figure bothers me most? | Where might that quality live in me, even a little? | What could it offer me if I accepted it?
questions_zh: 这个人物身上最让我在意的特质是什么？| 这种特质在我身上是否也有一点？| 如果接纳它，它能给我什么？
avoid: Equating the shadow with "evil", or with any group of people.
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 17–18; Schwartz-Salant & Stein (eds.), Dreams in Analysis (1990), p. 191

possibility_en: The face you show the world. It often appears as clothing, uniforms or masks: wrong clothes, ridiculous outfits or nakedness can point to how well that public face fits right now.
possibility_zh: 你展示给外界的样子，常以衣服、制服或面具出现。穿错衣服、装扮可笑或赤身，可能在提示这张“面孔”此刻是否合身。
questions_en: What was I wearing, and how did it feel? | Who was I trying to be for others? | Where does my public face feel too tight or too thin?
questions_zh: 我穿着什么？感觉如何？| 我在为谁扮演什么角色？| 我的“外在面孔”哪里太紧、哪里太薄？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 17–18, 105

aliases: stranger|unknown person|mysterious figure|guide|lover|陌生人|神秘人物
possibility_en: A figure who feels unfamiliar yet compelling, carrying qualities you have not yet developed: tenderness, decisiveness, creativity, structure, relatedness. It can be of any gender.
possibility_zh: 一个陌生却吸引你的人物，承载着你尚未发展的特质，如温柔、果断、创造力、条理或联结。它可以是任何性别。
questions_en: What quality does this figure have that I lack or hold back? | How did I feel toward them? | What would it look like to live a little of that quality?
questions_zh: 这个人物有什么我缺少或压抑的特质？| 我对他／她／TA的感觉是什么？| 如果我活出一点那种特质，会是什么样子？
avoid: Assigning traits to a gender, or assuming the dreamer is heterosexual or cisgender.
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 17–18, 67, 88
inclusive_note: Reframed from Jung’s anima (the "feminine side of a man") and animus (the "masculine side of a woman"): a figure of any gender, carrying any undeveloped quality.

possibility_en: The sense of a larger wholeness beyond the everyday "I". It tends to appear as circles, centers, treasures, radiant figures or a feeling of deep rightness, often when life feels fragmented or when something is coming together.
possibility_zh: 超越日常“我”的整体感，常以圆形、中心、宝物、发光的形象或一种深深的“对了”的感觉出现，往往在生活零散或正在整合时到来。
questions_en: What felt whole or centered in this dream? | What in my life is asking to come together? | What gives me that feeling awake?
questions_zh: 梦里什么让我感到完整或安定？| 生活中有什么正在等待被整合？| 醒着时什么能给我这种感觉？
avoid: Reading it as a religious claim; the Self is open to any faith or none.
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 17, 78, 99; Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), p. 278

aliases: teacher|elder|guide|old woman|old man|mentor|老人|老师|导师
possibility_en: A figure who knows more than you and offers help, direction or a hard truth. Often your own capacity for wisdom, not yet trusted.
possibility_zh: 比你懂得更多、给予帮助、方向或逆耳真话的人物，常常是你自身尚未信任的智慧。
questions_en: What did the guide tell or show me? | Do I believe it? | Where in my life could I listen to this kind of wisdom?
questions_zh: 引导者告诉或展示了我什么？| 我相信吗？| 生活中哪里可以听从这种智慧？
avoid: Assuming the guide must be an old man.
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), p. 67; Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), pp. 42, 288
inclusive_note: Jung’s "wise old man" opened to a wise figure of any age or gender.

possibility_en: Care that feeds you, or care that holds on too tightly. Can be about a real caregiver or about how you care for yourself and others.
possibility_zh: 滋养你的照料，或抓得太紧的照料。可能关于现实中的照顾者，也可能关于你如何照顾自己和他人。
questions_en: Did this care feel nourishing or confining? | Who in my life is this about, if anyone? | How do I care for myself right now?
questions_zh: 这份照料让我感到被滋养还是被束缚？| 它可能关于生活中的谁？| 我现在如何照顾自己？
avoid: Equating care with mothers or women.
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 67, 100; Schwartz-Salant & Stein (eds.), Dreams in Analysis (1990), pp. 19, 48
inclusive_note: Jung’s "Great Mother" and "mother as origin of life" read as caregiving that anyone can give.

possibility_en: Something new and vulnerable: a beginning, a possibility, or an earlier part of you. The child’s age can point to what was happening in your life that many years ago.
possibility_zh: 新生而脆弱的东西：一个开端、一种可能，或更早的你。孩子的年龄，可能指向你那么多年前生活中发生的事。
questions_en: How old was the child, and what was my life like back then? | What new beginning might this be? | Did I protect it or neglect it?
questions_zh: 孩子几岁？那时我的生活是什么样子？| 这可能是什么新的开始？| 我保护了它，还是忽略了它？
avoid: Reading it as a wish or a warning about pregnancy.
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 55, 67

possibility_en: Often the psyche itself: different floors as different layers of experience, the cellar as older or deeper material, an unknown room as a part of yourself you are just discovering.
possibility_zh: 常象征心灵本身：不同楼层是不同层次的经验，地下室是更古老或更深的部分，未知的房间是你刚刚发现的自己。
questions_en: Which part of the house was I in? | Was there a room I didn’t know about? | What state was the house in?
questions_zh: 我在房子的哪一部分？| 有没有我不知道的房间？| 房子是什么状况？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 28, 86

possibility_en: The flow of life and feeling, and the unconscious itself. Crossing water can mean getting past an obstacle; moving water can trace an inner journey across a dream series.
possibility_zh: 生命与情感的流动，也象征潜意识本身。渡水可能意味着越过障碍；流动的水在一系列梦中，可能描绘一段内在旅程。
questions_en: Was the water calm, clear, rough or murky? | Was I in it, on it, or watching it? | What feelings in my life feel this way?
questions_zh: 水是平静、清澈、汹涌还是浑浊？| 我在水中、水上，还是在旁观？| 生活中哪些感受像这样的水？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 77, 88, 93

possibility_en: A transition: moving from one stage of life or one attitude into another. Being unable to find the way across can mirror feeling stuck at a turning point.
possibility_zh: 一次过渡：从人生的一个阶段或一种态度走向另一个。找不到过去的路，可能映照出在转折处卡住的感觉。
questions_en: What was I leaving, and what was I entering? | What stopped me, if anything? | What threshold am I at in my life?
questions_zh: 我在离开什么、进入什么？| 有什么阻挡了我？| 我现在站在人生的哪个门槛前？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 140–141

possibility_en: How you are moving through life, and who or what is in control. Someone else driving, losing control or a breakdown can reflect who is steering a part of your life right now.
possibility_zh: 你如何在生活中前行，以及谁在掌控方向。别人在开车、失控或抛锚，可能反映此刻是谁在操纵你生活的某一部分。
questions_en: Who was driving? | Did I feel safe or out of control? | Where in my life am I a passenger?
questions_zh: 谁在驾驶？| 我感到安全还是失控？| 生活中哪里我只是乘客？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 76, 88; Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), p. 47

possibility_en: Something in you or your life that wants attention and keeps following until you turn around. Facing or accepting the pursuer in imagination often changes it into something less frightening.
possibility_zh: 你内在或生活中想被看见的东西，会一直追着你，直到你转身。在想象中面对或接纳追赶者，它往往会变得不那么可怕。
questions_en: What or who was chasing me? | What might happen if I stopped and turned around? | What am I avoiding facing?
questions_zh: 是什么或谁在追我？| 如果我停下来转身，会发生什么？| 我在回避面对什么？
avoid: Labelling the pursuer as a person in waking life without asking.
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), p. 73; Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), pp. 199–203

possibility_en: Instinct and the body’s own knowing. What the animal means depends on your associations: a dog and a cat in the same spot of a dream can carry very different meanings.
possibility_zh: 本能与身体的智慧。动物的意义取决于你的联想：同一位置上的狗和猫，可能有很不同的含义。
questions_en: What do I associate with this animal? | Was it wild, tame, hurt, helpful? | What instinct of mine might it carry?
questions_zh: 我对这种动物有什么联想？| 它是野性的、温顺的、受伤的还是乐于助人的？| 它可能承载了我的哪种本能？
avoid: Using fixed animal meanings from a list; treating an animal as a judgment about a gender.
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 52, 73, 100
inclusive_note: Dropped Mattoon’s example reading a wolf as "a pursuer of women".

possibility_en: Fear, healing and transformation all at once: a bite can stop you in your tracks, and shedding skin speaks of renewal. Which it is depends on the dream and on you.
possibility_zh: 同时关乎恐惧、疗愈与转化：被咬可能让你停下脚步，蜕皮则意味着更新。是哪一种，取决于梦境和你自己。
questions_en: What did the snake do, and what did I do? | Does it feel dangerous, wise, or both? | What in me is ready to shed a skin?
questions_zh: 蛇做了什么？我又做了什么？| 它让人觉得危险、智慧，还是兼而有之？| 我身上有什么准备蜕皮了？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 37–38, 71, 174; Schwartz-Salant & Stein (eds.), Dreams in Analysis (1990), pp. 23, 26

aliases: clothes|naked|nude|undressed|wrong clothes|衣服|裸体|没穿衣服
possibility_en: Clothing often shows the persona. Incongruous or absurd clothing can point to something absurd in an attitude; nakedness can mean being seen as you are, which may feel exposing or freeing.
possibility_zh: 衣着常代表人格面具。不协调或可笑的衣着可能提示某种态度的荒谬；赤裸可能意味着被看见真实的自己，可能令人难堪，也可能令人释放。
questions_en: How did it feel to be dressed this way, or undressed? | Who saw me? | What would it mean to be seen as I am?
questions_zh: 这样穿着或赤裸，感觉如何？| 谁看见了我？| 被看见真实的我，意味着什么？
avoid: Treating nakedness as shameful or sexualizing it.
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 18, 105

possibility_en: Usually an ending that makes room for something new, not a literal death. An image that would be terrible in waking life can be good news for the psyche, such as letting go of an old role.
possibility_zh: 通常是为新事物腾出空间的结束，而非真正的死亡。清醒时可怕的画面，对心灵来说可能是好消息，比如放下一个旧角色。
questions_en: What or who died, and what does that stand for in my life? | What might be ending? | What could begin in its place?
questions_zh: 死去的是什么或谁？它在我生活中代表什么？| 什么可能正在结束？| 什么可能随之开始？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 3, 107; Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), p. 199
inclusive_note: Excluded Jung’s inference of a fatal illness from a dream (M 100).

aliases: dead parent|dead relative|ghost|ancestor|去世的亲人|已故|鬼|祖先
possibility_en: Unfinished feeling, a relationship continuing inside you, or qualities of that person you now carry. A dialogue with the figure can bring words that were never said.
possibility_zh: 未完成的情感、在你心中延续的关系，或你如今承载的那个人的特质。与这个人物对话，可能说出从未说出口的话。
questions_en: What did they say or want? | What was left unsaid between us? | What of them lives on in me?
questions_zh: 他们说了什么、想要什么？| 我们之间还有什么没说？| 他们的什么在我身上延续？
avoid: Claiming contact with the dead as fact, or denying it to someone who experiences it so.
sources: Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), pp. 22, 244, 290

possibility_en: Freedom and new perspective, or an inflated sense of self that is rising above the ground of real life. Which one depends on how the flight felt and what was below.
possibility_zh: 自由与新的视角，或一种膨胀的自我感，正在脱离现实的地面。是哪一种，取决于飞行的感觉和下方是什么。
questions_en: Did flying feel joyful, effortful or dangerous? | What was I rising above? | Is there somewhere I need to come back down to earth, or somewhere I need more lift?
questions_zh: 飞行让人感到喜悦、吃力还是危险？| 我在飞越什么？| 生活中哪里需要回到地面，哪里需要更多升力？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), p. 67; Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), p. 265

possibility_en: Growth over time, roots and rootedness, the family tree, and renewal. Its health in the dream can mirror your sense of your own growth.
possibility_zh: 随时间的成长、根与扎根、家族之树，以及重生。梦中树的状况，可能映照你对自身成长的感受。
questions_en: What state was the tree in? | Where are my roots? | What is growing in me right now?
questions_zh: 树是什么状态？| 我的根在哪里？| 我身上正在生长的是什么？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 56, 89; Schwartz-Salant & Stein (eds.), Dreams in Analysis (1990), p. 60

possibility_en: Intensity: passion, anger, energy or transformation. Fire can destroy, warm, light the way, or feel sacred, as in a fire that is not put out.
possibility_zh: 强烈的能量：激情、愤怒、活力或转化。火可以毁灭、温暖、照亮道路，也可能让人感到神圣，比如一团不灭之火。
questions_en: Was the fire destructive, warming or illuminating? | What in my life feels this intense? | What is being transformed?
questions_zh: 火是毁灭的、温暖的还是照亮的？| 生活中什么同样强烈？| 什么正在被转化？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 62, 232; Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), p. 34

possibility_en: An image of wholeness and order. It may appear when life feels fragmented, as a counterweight, or when a deeper integration is already underway.
possibility_zh: 整体与秩序的意象。可能在生活零散时作为平衡出现，也可能在更深的整合已经开始时出现。
questions_en: What was at the center? | Did the circle feel protective or confining? | What is coming together in my life?
questions_zh: 中心是什么？| 这个圆让人感到被保护还是被困住？| 生活中什么正在汇聚？
sources: Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), pp. 78, 99; Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), p. 232

possibility_en: Something valuable that is hard to reach or freely given: a capacity, an insight, a relationship. Often linked with the Self.
possibility_zh: 难以获得或被白白赠予的珍贵之物：一种能力、一个领悟、一段关系，常与自性相关。
questions_en: What was the treasure, and where was it? | What did it take to reach it, or who gave it? | What in me is this valuable?
questions_zh: 宝物是什么？在哪里？| 得到它需要付出什么，或是谁给的？| 我身上什么同样珍贵？
sources: Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), pp. 34, 232, 278; Schwartz-Salant & Stein (eds.), Dreams in Analysis (1990), p. 53

possibility_en: Two different things coming together: opposites in yourself uniting, a commitment, or a new stage. It is not necessarily about a real relationship.
possibility_zh: 两种不同的东西走到一起：内在对立面的结合、一份承诺，或一个新阶段。不一定关于现实中的关系。
questions_en: Who or what was being joined? | How did I feel about the union? | What in me is ready to come together?
questions_zh: 谁和谁、什么和什么在结合？| 我对这次结合有什么感觉？| 我身上什么准备好结合了？
avoid: Assuming a heterosexual couple or reading it as advice to marry.
sources: Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), p. 278; Mattoon, Applied Dream Analysis (1978), p. 90
inclusive_note: Read gender-neutrally; any union, any partners.

possibility_en: Not a prediction. A nightmare often wakes you at the moment of greatest fear. In imagination you can go back in, face or befriend the threat, and rewrite the ending toward resolution.
possibility_zh: 噩梦并非预兆，往往在最恐惧的时刻让你惊醒。在想象中你可以回到梦里，面对或接纳威胁，把结局改写为化解。
questions_en: What was the threat, and what did it want? | How could the dream end differently? | What support do I need to face this?
questions_zh: 威胁是什么？它想要什么？| 梦可以怎样换一个结局？| 面对它，我需要什么支持？
avoid: Pushing interpretation on trauma; suggest professional support for recurring, distressing nightmares.
sources: Williams, The Jungian-Senoi Dreamwork Manual (rev. 1985), pp. 199–203, 310–311
inclusive_note: Credited to Williams and modern dreamwork, not to the Senoi people (see W 301–302).
